sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 760. Success value 100. 3x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Erosion (nullifies effects that penetrate nullifying or invulnerability effects when using an attack Ability) for 60 seconds.
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Diffusion. The next Ability used will change from a specified single/range target to targeting all (except for certain Abilities).
-Target: all allies. Applies 50% elevation for 150 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 60. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Rampart for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all elemental Unison damage Ability Power by 200; [Special] increases success value of all status ailment attacks, including Unison Effects and Ability Effects, by 50; nullifies special debuffs; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Infinite Element (increases all stats by 120%, restores 5% of damage dealt as HP, and increases HP recovery effects by 50%) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 80% for 150 seconds.
Light and Star Defense from Unison Damage +700
